title: Network Discovery
subtitle: Scan your network to find monitorable hosts
noScansDescription: Start a scan to discover hosts on your network.
scanAlreadyRunning: A discovery scan is already running for this organization. Stop it or wait for it to finish.
scanNotAvailable: This discovery source is not available on this server.
noChecksDescription: Start a scan to discover suggested checks, or wait for the current scan to complete.
cidrsHelp: Enter one CIDR range per line. Large ranges are split into bounded chunks that scan progressively.
stopScanConfirm: Stop this scan? Pending chunks will be dropped; chunks already running will finish.
confirmation: I confirm I own or have permission to scan the listed network(s).
portsHelp: Comma-separated port numbers. Leave empty to use defaults.
containerHostsHelp: One Docker-compatible endpoint per line, e.g. unix:///var/run/docker.sock or tcp://10.0.0.5:2375. Use a tcp:// endpoint for hosts other than the one running the worker.
clusterNamespacesHelp: Comma-separated namespaces to scan. Leave empty to scan every visible namespace.
workerNote: Note: Discovery scans run on the in-process worker, or from a private location when one is selected.
name: Check name
largeRangeWarning: Large range: ~{{hosts}} addresses across {{chunks}} chunks. This scan may take a long time (hours to days).
scanRegionUnavailable: No agent of this location is ready to scan. Set SP_AGENT_DISCOVERY_ENABLED on its agent.
scanQuotaExceeded: This organization's daily limit of addresses scanned from private locations is reached. Try again tomorrow (UTC).
regionDiscoveryOff: discovery not enabled (set SP_AGENT_DISCOVERY_ENABLED on its agent)
regionHelp: Scan from the server, or from a private location to reach a network the server cannot.
regionRequiredHelp: This server cannot scan the LAN itself. Pick a private location.
workerNoteRegion: This scan runs from {{region}}, using the agent's network. Only the ranges its operator allowed can be scanned.
promoteRegionNote: Checks promoted from this scan will run from {{region}}.

chunkError.DISCOVERY_NOT_ALLOWED: The range is outside what the agent's operator allowed (SP_AGENT_DISCOVERY_CIDRS).
chunkError.DISCOVERY_DISABLED: Discovery is not enabled on the agent (SP_AGENT_DISCOVERY_ENABLED).
chunkError.DISCOVERY_EGRESS_REFUSED: The agent's egress policy refused the scan.
chunkError.DISCOVERY_INVALID_CHUNK: The agent rejected the chunk as invalid.
